name: q2s05e-spoke-sees-hub
goal: A Tracker spoke reports the hub's real launch wait reason and runner state (q2s05ejftz). Coverage gap: tracker-due-launch spoke+hub test never read the spoke's launch wait or computers list after a machine exchange.

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: MB2 on release 7b36a973a2 showed 'waiting for daniel-primary-mbp to sync' while the primary polled. Expected: queued/held reason from the hub's own report. Cause: hub machine list returned by /sync/machine only held spoke samples.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: tracker-due-launch spoke+hub test never exchanged machine telemetry, then read the spoke's launch_status or autolaunch computers; extended it with both.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: At a7c4970c72 the extended test failed: launch_status reason 'waiting for daniel-primary-mbp to sync', expected 'queued on daniel-primary-mbp'.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Hub sync response now appends the hub's own current runner report (trackerHubMachines); commit 866eac28a2.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Same unchanged test passed at 866eac28a2 (harness loop record --phase green).

steps.title: Run harness loop siblings to record the root cause and evaluate the same pattern across committed source.
Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
